headline: CrowdStrike bets on network security with acquisition of Zscaler for 43,900 million dollars
summary: CrowdStrike announced it will acquire Zscaler in an entirely stock-based transaction that values the company at about $43.9 billion. The deal expands CrowdStrike's push into network security.
why: CrowdStrike is a US cybersecurity company, and Zscaler is a cloud security provider focused on secure network access. Large security deals reshape competition across the enterprise software market.

impacts.name: Zscaler
impacts.why: Named as the target of an all-stock acquisition valuing the company at about $43.9 billion.
